caption:
Got a call at 2am. Guy in Brickell, 2019 BMW 330i, no key, dealer told him to tow it.

Most locksmiths would've said the same thing. CAS module, BMW, 2am... not worth the headache.

I drove out anyway. 40 minutes later he had a working key and I had a story.

Lesson: the jobs everybody else turns down are the ones that build your name.

What's the wildest late-night call you've ever taken?
